courses.title: Meditation for Anxiety
courses.description: A short self-paced online course of about four hours of video on working with anxiety through meditation and energy awareness. It covers seven mindful tools, boundaries, self-compassion through metta practice and moving from a victim mindset to an empowered one, with guided meditations and a beginner's ebook.

courses.title: Stress Mastery: 21 Days of Freedom
courses.description: A three-week online programme combining meditation, coaching and simple energy tools for handling everyday stress. Each week brings teachings, guided practices, journal prompts and worksheets, with a year of streaming access.

courses.title: RESILIENCE Executive Retreats
courses.description: Private, custom retreats for business leaders in the Pacific Northwest, booked on request as a half day, a full day or a weekend. They combine meditation coaching, relaxation practices, time in nature and practical workshops on meeting pressure calmly.

left_out: Insight Timer courses 'Advanced Chakra Healing For Women' and 'Learn How To Manifest With Energy': on Insight Timer, which we never fetch.
Beginner Sura Flow Energy Practitioner Training (began 15 Oct 2025) and the 7-week Energy Healer Practitioner Program (began 10 Sep 2026): both dated and already started; out on the date rule.

Blog posts ('How to Manage Stress and Anxiety with Meditation', 'Does Meditation Reverse Aging?' and others): articles rather than free practices; not added. ALL-IN Concierge Executive Stress Program: a wellness package of massage, nutrition and fitness from a team, not her teaching.
The listing reaches the 10-offering cap with these three.
flags: Meditation for Anxiety speaks of releasing anxiety as 'an energetic state'; it names no disorder and makes no claim to treat one. Kept under the new rule.
RESILIENCE Executive Retreats: custom corporate retreats with no dates or price; mainly stress relief and leadership, closer to coaching than spiritual teaching. A human may prefer to drop it.
